chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Rehearsals, jamming and Body and Soul
summary: The band rehearsed sometimes and jammed, and Henderson featured soloists on numbers like Body and Soul.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: There are some other things about the Fletcher Henderson band that I would like to know about. I had asked about the practicing; you say you never heard any of the musicians really practicing.
Did you all jam together and play music other than the music you were playing with Fletcher Henderson?
Was Fletcher Henderson playing like that?
Would Fletcher Henderson play a song like 'Body and Soul'?

He featured it with somebody in the band - he featured it with a guy in the band. You know, just like any other band, if you had a solo you wanted to play, then you know, call on him, he'd go ahead and do it.
